title: Fujimori y Perú
goal: Read about Alberto Fujimori's surprise 1990 election, the "Fujishock" adjustment program, the 1992 autogolpe, and the capture of Abimael Guzmán.

items: Explain who Alberto Fujimori was and how he won in 1990.
Explain what happened in the 1992 autogolpe.
Name who was captured in September 1992 and why it mattered.
Use de la mano de to describe who or what drove an event.
